contract_teleradiology:cancel.inverse: none: a fixed end cannot be moved or withdrawn (already_cancelled); coverage returns only through a new contract, with 14 days' notice
contract_teleradiology:cancel.retained: the retainer to the end; claims already made complete at their fees

contract_teleradiology:start.effective: the activation, at least 14 days ahead
contract_teleradiology:start.notice: a cancellation ends at least 30 days ahead and at least 30 days after activation
contract_teleradiology:start.retained: the retainer to the minimum-term end, payable even if cancelled before activation
contract_teleradiology:start.reversalCost: the preview's guaranteed retainer (GuaranteedCents through GuaranteedThrough)

extend_shift.inverse: none: no action withdraws an approved extension; a later roster change or termination can void it
extend_shift.retained: the extra time is paid as worked

hire.effective: the start date (at least the offer's lead time ahead)
hire.notice: a termination's last day is at least 14 days after both today and the start date
hire.retained: the recruiting fee (recognized at acceptance, not refunded), the contract guarantee to the last day, and two contracted weeks' severance with benefits
hire.reversalCost: the preview's "Earliest lawful exit" line: the guarantee from the start to the earliest last day plus severance; the recruiting fee in addition

set_reading_allocation.effective: a dated version, at least 14 days ahead
set_reading_allocation.inverse: op remove of the pending version, until the preview's withdrawBy date (the same notice); after that, a new set with 14 days' notice
set_reading_allocation.notice: 14 days; once in force an allocation stays in force at least 14 days
set_reading_allocation.retained: nothing while withdrawable; once in force, the salary accrued under it

set_roster.effective: a Monday at least 14 days ahead
set_roster.inverse: op remove of the pending version up to 14 days before it takes effect; a version in effect or past never changes
set_roster.notice: 14 days, also to remove a pending version
set_roster.retained: the contract guarantee is owed whatever is rostered: no roster change saves or costs pay

terminate.effective: employment ends at the midnight after the last day
terminate.inverse: none: a termination cannot be moved or withdrawn (already_terminating); capacity returns only through a new hire, with its own fee and lead time
terminate.notice: at least 14 days; contract pay continues to the last day
terminate.retained: severance (two contracted weeks, recognized at acceptance) and contract pay to the last day
